name: proxmox
description: Proxmox VE integration for VM and container management. Monitor cluster health and resources, run approval-gated lifecycle actions, clone from templates, take create-only snapshots, and lease disposable VMs from a governed pool. Agent writes always need a human approval; the platform-wide E-STOP and DEFCON controls apply to the HYPERION agent, there is no Proxmox-specific kill switch.
shortDescription: VM and container management for Proxmox clusters.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Disposable VM pool: lanes, warm standby, made-to-order
quox vm CLI and /vm in chat
